newsitem.title: USA: Delaware taps ex-state senator for bi-state agency.
newsitem.headline: Delaware taps ex-state senator for bi-state agency.

text.p: Delaware Gov Thomas Carper said on Monday he nominated the former Senate President Pro Tempore, Richard Cordrey, to serve on the Delaware River and Bay Authority.
The agency, a 12-member body that has six residents from Delaware and six from New Jersey, operates, develops and maintains transportation and commerce along Delware River and Bay.
If confirmed by the Senate, Cordrey would serve a term that ends on July 1, 1997.
